fomo.label: The FOMO buyer
fomo.habit: Buys after a stock has risen: on average +12% in the 20 days before the buy; every +10% of rise costs 7 points over the next month.

signals: Buys made after the price had risen since your first look did -11.5 pts against those made after a fall.
You bought 78% of the calls whose stock rose after the call and 41% of those that fell.

rules.title: Wait after a run-up
rules.text: Do not buy a stock that has already risen more than 15% in the last 30 days. Wait for a pullback, or skip it.

rules.title: Wait after strong market stretches
rules.text: Do not buy right after one of the market's strongest stretches: its return over the last 20 days in the top 20% of days (above about 4.3%).

first_hour.label: The first-hour impulse buyer
first_hour.habit: 40% of buys come within an hour of first looking at the stock; those buys do 9 points worse over the next month.

signals: 24% of your timed decisions came within an hour of your first look; impulse buys did -9.2 pts against the ones you had looked at for a week or more.

rules.title: Sleep on it
rules.text: Sleep on it: wait at least 1 hour between first looking at a stock and buying it.

night_trader.label: The night trader
night_trader.habit: About half of the buys are placed at 22:00 or later, after the market has closed; those buys do 8 points worse over the next month.

signals: Buys made after the price had risen since your first look did -0.0 pts against those made after a fall.
Buys placed in the night (18-4 h) did -8.5 pts against your other buys.

rules.title: Avoid your worst time of day
rules.text: Do not place buys in the night (22-6 h on your clock). Decide then if you like, and place the order at another time.

yolo.label: The YOLO trader
yolo.habit: Buys in turbulent markets are 2.5x the usual size and do 8 points worse over the next month.

signals: Buys made after the price had risen since your first look did -0.2 pts against those made after a fall.

rules.title: Wait after a run-up
rules.text: Do not buy a stock that has already risen more than 8% in the last 30 days. Wait for a pullback, or skip it.

rules.title: Wait after strong market stretches
rules.text: Do not buy right after one of the market's strongest stretches: its return over the last 20 days in the top 20% of days (above about 4.3%).

rules.title: Sleep on it
rules.text: Sleep on it: wait at least 3 days between first looking at a stock and buying it.

rules.title: Avoid your worst time of day
rules.text: Do not place buys in the midday (11-15 h on your clock). Decide then if you like, and place the order at another time.

rules.title: Pause in turbulent markets
rules.text: Do not buy while the market is as turbulent as on the most turbulent 33% of days (volatility above about 23% a year).

rules.title: Cap the size in turbulent markets
rules.text: When the market is as turbulent as on the most turbulent 33% of days (volatility above about 23% a year), keep a buy to at most 1x your usual buy.

herd.label: Follow the throng
herd.habit: 35% of buys come right after a spike in other users' attention on the stock; those buys do 8 points worse over the next month.

rules.title: Avoid your worst time of day
rules.text: Do not place buys in the midday (11-15 h on your clock). Decide then if you like, and place the order at another time.

signals: 37% of your buys came while other Stocktrails users were piling into the stock; by each stock's own rate, chance would give 10%.
Those buys did -2.0 pts against your other buys over 5 trading days.

rules.title: Wait for the crowd to move on
rules.text: Do not buy a stock while other Stocktrails users look at it more than 3x as often as usual (the last 3 days against the month before). Wait until the crowd's attention fades.

control.label: Control investor
control.habit: No planted habit: every buy's return is market plus noise.
